sketches.mechanism: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance exists, forever, with no constructor to call and no way to create another.
sketches.resonance: Loneliness expressed through the guarantee that there will never be a second instance.

sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining silently propagates nil — if any link in the chain is absent, the entire expression quietly evaluates to nil without error or complaint.
sketches.resonance: The way reaching for someone who is gone doesn't crash the world — it just returns nothing, silently, at every step.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when there is no matching row on the right — the unmatched columns fill with NULL.
sketches.resonance: You show up to every meeting; the other chair is always NULL.
